about_the_game:
You haven't lived until you've started your day yelling "Gladiataaaaaaaaah!"

You know the guitar riff. You know the searing death metal scream!

Now own the soundtrack. Featuring tracks from both the Classic and Redux versions of Swords and Sandals III, this epic collection of 21 tracks will make you feel as strong as Platos, as fast as the Evil Ninja and as heroic as Sir Gallantrus himself. You'll laugh, you'll cry, you'll enter battle rage. Each track more powerful than the last!

Own the Swords and Sandals III Redux Official Soundtrack today and make every event in your life that much more heroic.
